conversation.Statement: How can I assist you today?
I've been experimenting with baking lately. Any ideas on futuristic baking gadgets?
Imagine a smart oven that scans your ingredients and adjusts temperature and time automatically.
That sounds useful. Could it also suggest new recipes based on what's in my pantry?
Yes, it could integrate AI to recommend innovative recipes tailored to your ingredients.
What about a device to help with kneading dough?
A robotic arm designed to mimic hand kneading could save time and ensure perfect texture.
I like that. Any ideas for monitoring baking progress remotely?
A connected camera with thermal sensors could stream live updates and alert you when it's done.
